notes.title: 1.1 Released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638873/51f077633035c40ef0af40ac8f8c84d5a03ecc9b.png"][/img][/p][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][list][*][p]Added New Slot Spins:[/p][list][*][p]Extended Paddle[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Ball[/p][/*][*][p]Bumpers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cosmetics: The Vault has been added, you can now spend the chips you earn![/p][list][*][p]Red Ball[/p][/*][*][p]Rainbow Trail[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements[/p][list][*][p]Big Spender: unlock a cosmetic[/p][/*][*][p]All In: earn 5000 in one run[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Full Controller Support[/p][/*][*][p]Linux and Steam Deck Support[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed screen clipping on different aspect ratio displays[/p][/*][*][p]Better weights for slot rolls[/p][/*][*][p]Various other minor issues[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
